newsitem.title: USA: Ford close to selling Budget Rent A Car - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Ford close to selling Budget Rent A Car - NYT.

text.p: Team Rental Group Inc is expected to announce on Monday that it is buying the Budget Rent A Car Company for more than $350 million in cash and stock from Ford Motor Co, The New York Times reported on Monday.
The expected move is part of a trend of auto makers exiting the rental business that they once dominated, the newspaper said.
Team Rental is a company of used car outlets and Budget franchisees and would immediately become a major force in the rental industry, the story said.
It cited a person close to the negotiations who said Ford and Team Rental were putting finishing touches to the deal during meetings with lawyers on Sunday.
